description: Search Skiplagged for flight fares by route, or batch multiple routes / paste Skiplagged search URLs.

airlines.description: Only emit itineraries that include at least one of these 2-letter IATA airline codes, e.g. `AA`, `BA`, `DL`.
airlines.title: Filter by airline IATA codes

cabinClass.description: Requested cabin class. Skiplagged's public search does not always honor this — the real `fareClass` returned by the upstream is always included on every record.
cabinClass.title: Cabin class

departDate.description: Departure date as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Leave blank to default to 6 weeks from today (keeps the daily test run always valid).
departDate.title: Departure date (mode=search)

destination.description: Destination IATA airport code (e.g. `LHR`) or metro/city code (e.g. `LON` covers LHR, LGW, STN, LTN, LCY).
destination.title: Destination (mode=search)

infantsLap.description: Number of lap infants (under 2, no seat).
infantsLap.title: Infants (on lap)

infantsSeat.description: Number of infants (under 2) with their own seat.
infantsSeat.title: Infants (own seat)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (per run, across all routes).
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Drop itineraries pricier than this (whole USD).
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

maxStops.description: Drop itineraries with more stops than this.
maxStops.title: Max stops

minPrice.description: Drop itineraries cheaper than this (whole USD).
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

enumTitles: Search multiple routes in one run
mode.title: Mode

origin.description: Origin IATA airport code (e.g. `JFK`) or metro/city code (e.g. `NYC` covers JFK, LGA, EWR).
origin.title: Origin (mode=search)

returnDate.description: Return date as `YYYY-MM-DD` for a round-trip search. Leave blank for a one-way search.
returnDate.title: Return date (mode=search)

routes.description: Batch of routes to search in one run. Each item: `{"origin":"NYC","destination":"LON","departDate":"2026-09-01","returnDate":"2026-09-08"}` (`returnDate` optional for one-way).
routes.title: Routes (mode=byRoutes)

tripType.description: One-way or round-trip. Auto-detected from whether a return date is present; this only matters when `returnDate` is ambiguous.
tripType.title: Trip type

title: Skiplagged Flight Search Scraper Input
